title: pleurolobus canadensis
intro: Pleurolobus canadensis, commonly known as Canadian plum or American plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fighting off infections due to its antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral effects. Pleurolobus canadensis has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
